title: Assessing the Predictive Value of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for the No-Reflow Phenomenon in ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction: A Comparative Machine Learning Study.
summary: In a prospective single-center cohort of 890 patients undergoing primary PCI for STEMI, the study compared supervised models for predicting no-reflow. Kolmogorov-Arnold Network and XGBoost models reported AUC above 0.98 and F1 above 0.95, exceeding logistic-regression and decision-tree comparators in the study. External validation is still needed.
